description: This file defines an internal helper class `AdoGrainKey` used within Orleans.Storage to manage grain key information for database operations. It provides constructors for different key types, methods to generate hash bytes, and a string representation of the key.

classes.name: AdoGrainKey
classes.description: Helper class to manage grain key information with support for long, GUID, and string keys. Includes methods for key representation and hashing.

methods.name: AdoGrainKey
methods.description: Constructor for long key with key extension.

methods.name: AdoGrainKey
methods.description: Constructor for GUID key with key extension.

methods.name: GetHashBytes
methods.description: Returns a byte array representing the hash of the key, combining relevant byte data depending on key type.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the grain key.
